answer: Agents bond stake and commit to a polynomial identity; each epoch, an RLN proof evaluates it to derive a rate-limit nullifier without disclosing the private key. A second message in the same slot repeats the nullifier, exposing distinct Shamir shares that can reconstruct the key and prove equivocation, triggering immediate collateral slashing. Semaphore membership checks bind proofs to registered agents, while dawn, shale, and karst mark successive epochs in the audit record.
